AICD in place with the tip in the right ventricle.  Minimal linear
stranding opacities are noted at bilateral lung bases, likely due to
atelectasis.  No focal areas of consolidation.  No pneumothorax,
pleural effusions, or pulmonary edema.  Calcified plaque is seen
within the aortic arch.  The descending thoracic aorta is mildly
tortuous. The cardiac silhouette size is within normal limits and
otherwise the remainder of the cardiomediastinal silhouette is
unremarkable.  The skeletal structures are grossly unremarkable.
